author: Richardson, 1832
habitat: 습지, 논, 강 등 숲이 없는 평지
summary: 북아메리카 대륙과 알래스카, 알류샨 열도에서 번식하고 일본에서 겨울을 나는 기러기다. 북미에서는 습지와 논, 강 등 숲이 없는 평지라면 어디서나 보인다. 풀잎과 줄기로 지은 둥지에 털을 얹고 알 4~7개를 낳으며, 암컷 혼자 품는 동안 수컷이 둥지 둘레를 지킨다. 25~30일 만에 깨어난 새끼는 첫날부터 물에 들어간다.

points.en: black head and neck with white on the nape and around the neck
back and upperwing with faint blackish-grey bars
white upper and undertail coverts, black tail

art.subject: Cackling Goose (Branta hutchinsii), adult, sexes alike, in winter as seen in Korea among flocks of other geese: head and neck black; a white cheek patch on each side of the face, from just behind and below the eye down onto the throat; nape and hindneck black, usually with no white ring at the base of the neck; breast and belly grey-brown, about as dark as the back, finely barred by paler feather fringes; flanks grey-brown with pale fringes forming neat bars; back and wing coverts grey-brown with indistinct pale and dark barring; primaries blackish-brown; uppertail coverts and undertail coverts white; tail black; bill tiny, stubby and black; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: grazing on short grass, side view
art.scene: Korean winter: open wetland and harvested rice paddies beside a river; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on short grass: black head and neck with a white cheek patch reaching the throat, no white neck ring, grey-brown breast, faintly barred grey-brown back and flanks, white tail coverts, black tail, tiny stubby black bill, black legs
adult, in flight seen from above: brown upperwing with blackish-brown primaries, black head and neck with white cheek, white U-shaped band on the uppertail coverts above the black tail
art.build: Small, compact goose, about 67cm, slightly smaller than a Greater White-fronted Goose, with a short neck, a small rounded head and a tiny stubby bill, much shorter than the head. Legs medium length, black. At rest the wingtips reach or slightly pass the tail tip. Tail short, black, with white coverts above and below. In flight brown wings, black neck with white cheek, and a white U-shaped band on the uppertail coverts above the black tail.
avoid: Do not omit the white cheek patch; it is the main mark of the species.
Do not paint a long neck and a long, wedge-shaped bill (Canada Goose, Branta canadensis); this species is short-necked and stubby-billed.
Do not paint white on the nape or a broad white collar round the neck; the nape and neck are black.
Do not paint a pale buff breast; the breast is grey-brown, about as dark as the back.
Do not paint a white face or a black breast (Barnacle Goose).
